description: This file defines the Configuration class and related functions for the behave testing framework, including command-line argument parsing, config file loading, and setup routines.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: Encapsulates the configuration settings for the behave testing framework, including command-line parsing, config file loading, and setup routines.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes or reinitializes the Configuration object with default and provided settings.

methods.name: make_defaults
methods.description: Creates a copy of default configuration values, overridden by any provided keyword arguments.

methods.name: has_colored_mode
methods.description: Determines if colored output should be enabled based on configuration and output stream.

methods.name: make_command_args
methods.description: Processes and normalizes command-line arguments, supporting various formats and auto-detection.

methods.name: setup_wip_mode
methods.description: Configures the environment for 'work in progress' mode, focusing on scenarios tagged with 'wip'.

methods.name: setup_steps_catalog_mode
methods.description: Configures the environment to show a catalog of steps, used for step overview.

methods.name: setup_select_by_filters
methods.description: Compiles regex filters for including/excluding files and scenarios based on user input.

methods.name: setup_reporters
methods.description: Initializes report modules like JUnit and summary reporters based on configuration.

methods.name: show_bad_formats_and_fail
methods.description: Checks for invalid formatters and raises errors if any are found.

methods.name: setup_tag_expression
methods.description: Builds the tag expression object from command-line and config file tags.

methods.name: setup_outputs
methods.description: Prepares output streams for formatter output, defaulting to stdout or specified files.

methods.name: setup_formats
methods.description: Registers additional user-defined formatters.

methods.name: setup_runner_aliases
methods.description: Registers additional runner class aliases.

methods.name: select_bad_formats_with_errors
methods.description: Returns a list of formatters that are invalid or cause errors.

methods.name: build_name_re
methods.description: Creates a regex for scenario selection based on provided names.

methods.name: exclude
methods.description: Determines if a filename should be excluded based on include/exclude regex filters.

methods.name: setup_logging
methods.description: Configures the logging subsystem according to settings.

methods.name: setup_model
methods.description: Sets up the ScenarioOutline annotation schema if specified.

methods.name: setup_stage
methods.description: Configures the test stage, including steps and environment files.

methods.name: setup_userdata
methods.description: Initializes and updates userdata object with configuration and command-line overrides.

methods.name: update_userdata
methods.description: Updates userdata with new data and reapplies command-line defines.

methods.name: should_capture
methods.description: Determines if output capturing is enabled.

methods.name: should_capture_hooks
methods.description: Determines if hook capturing is enabled.

methods.name: setup_capture
methods.description: Sets capture flags based on the 'capture' boolean setting.

methods.name: stdout_capture
methods.description: Deprecated property for capture_stdout with warning.

methods.name: stderr_capture
methods.description: Deprecated property for capture_stderr with warning.

methods.name: log_capture
methods.description: Deprecated property for capture_log with warning.
